module: Final global filter (runningOrder 1) that sends the computed pose (data.res) to the rendering engine: for the main view, setCameraPosRotFovNearClipC (with OpenXR, first combines the headset's predicted pose); for an extra context (split-screen, video stream), RenderViewManagerInstance:updateViewCamera with optional orthographic projection (res.ortho). Marks the main view 'cameraMotionContinuous' during big map transitions. Returns a constructor.
notes: Split-screen views narrower than 16:9 get a widened FOV (33% of the theoretical compensation). Far plane fixed at 2000 m for extra views.
Does not check levelLoaded: core_cameraUpdate only runs with a level loaded.

init.desc: isGlobal = true, runningOrder = 1, isFilter = true, hidden = true.

update.desc: Pushes data.res to the main view or to data.renderView.

data.desc: camData (data.renderView = view name, 'main' for the player)
